summary: Thanksgiving weekend brings Rudolph's opening at the Landers, Gardens Aglow's first nights, Missouri State football against No. 21 Liberty, a Last Waltz tribute and MOJO's Swingin' Christmas Saturday, and the new Branson Christkindlmarkt. Earlier in the week, the Turkey Trot runs Thanksgiving morning (snow is possible) and Christmas Vacation screens at the Gillioz on Black Friday.
